'''Borrigan's''' was a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] located in [[Livien Magnus]]' [[Cultural District]] from which [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] often bought [[Alcohol/Legends|drinks]]. A club was connected to the restaurant, which was named after [[Cadro Borrigan]] and served [[Iridian soufflé]].<ref name="OaA1" />
